plan: Given my value of $42, I aim to maximize profit by bidding slightly below my value to ensure a win while minimizing cost. Since values are uniformly distributed, I anticipate competitors' bids to average around $24.5. To outbid them without overpaying, I'll bid $35. This balances winning likelihood and profit maximization, ensuring I only pay if the second-highest bid is significantly lower than my value.

Given my value of $29, I aim to bid slightly below my value to maximize profit if I win. I must consider that other bidders might value the item similarly or more. A bid around $24 could deter lower bids while maintaining a potential profit margin. This balances the risk of overpaying and the opportunity to win.

Given my private value of $48, I aim to win while maximizing profit. A bid slightly below my value can deter overbidding but still be competitive. Since this is the only round, I will bid $47.9. This should be high enough to win against most bids given the range, while ensuring a profit if the second-highest bid is significantly lower.
